title: feat(nm2cycfrmy): cyclic-frame transport of (m,o_next,o_prev) at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Transport on the two-axis-opposite y-probes: hold,hold,hold,fail. Notable contrast the runner prints: the underlying Orient reverse FAILS (+1 vs -1) while the vacuous transport reverse HOLDs — the clearest single line showing transport is insensitive to the frame it claims to transport.
